name: RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (96GB): Llama 3.3 70B Q8_0 decode tokens/sec
methodology: llama.cpp CUDA backend, batch size 1, 512 token prompt, 128 token output, Q8_0 quantization, 96GB VRAM
notes: RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell with 96GB GDDR7 at 1792 GB/s. A 70B model at Q8_0 requires ~70GB of VRAM, fitting comfortably in 96GB. The 1792 GB/s bandwidth yields ~55 tokens/sec for decode. The RTX PRO 6000 is the only consumer/workstation GPU that can run a 70B model at 8-bit quantization with full GPU offload.
